data.name: Pack Bond
data.description: A packmaster can have more than one animal companion, but she must divide her effective druid level between her companions to determine the abilities of each one. For example, a 4th-level packmaster can have one 4th-level animal companion, two 2nd-level companions, one 3rd-level companion and one 1st-level companion, or four 1st-level companions. A packmaster's precise companion, woodland stride, and teamwork feats each apply to only one of her animal companions at a time.
